about: The slides of each page's 'Brief me' presentation (assets/briefing/briefing.js), keyed by page. Text may use {nodes}, {edges}, {companies}, {people}, {events}, {places}, filled at build from the graph so the slides say what the page shows and nothing more. href is a path from the site root. By dev.graphs@PrompTugal.dinis.

slides.title: The graph
slides.text: Companies, people, sessions, places, days, topics and the evidence behind them, joined by named relations. It is the newsroom's map of Web Summit Lisbon 2026, and every line names its source.

slides.title: Start from a question
slides.text: The explorer never starts from everything. Find a company, a person or a session and expand it one hop at a time, or pick a ready-made view from the Preset list and read the sentence under the bar.

slides.title: How is A connected to B?
slides.text: Name two nodes and the explorer finds the shortest paths between them and reads each as a sentence, with the relation on every step.

slides.title: Rank, filter, keep
slides.text: Keep the top few nodes or edges by PageRank, betweenness or degree; filter by world, type, relation, day, country and field; Save PNG downloads what is on screen; Copy link shares the exact view.

slides.title: The best of
slides.text: Eight ready-made views, each with a sentence on what it is telling you.
slides.link: Open the best of the graph

slides.title: Three pictures
slides.text: Centres of gravity shows where the companies gather by field or country. The industry map shows them as a tree by field. RiskMandate's ring shows the three questions asked of every company, none yet answered.

slides.title: Centres of gravity
slides.text: Each well is a field, or a country if you switch. Its size is the combined weight of its companies in the graph, and each dot is one company, bigger the more connected it is.

slides.title: What to look for
slides.text: A big well is where the graph's weight sits. A small well with a few big dots is a niche with a few well-connected names. Tap any dot for what the company does and a link to its page.

slides.title: Keep it
slides.text: Save as PNG downloads the picture as it is now. The same companies are drawn as a tree by field on the industry map and on the world map.

slides.title: The industry map
slides.text: The centre is the industry. Each wedge is a field, as the newsroom files its companies; the wider the wedge, the more companies it holds.

slides.title: Near the centre, well connected
slides.text: A company drawn close to the centre has more connections in the graph than one at the rim. The squares on the rim are programme tracks, placed on the field they map to.

slides.title: Keep going
slides.text: Replay redraws it from the centre; Save as PNG downloads it. For the three questions asked of every company, see RiskMandate's ring.

slides.title: RiskMandate's ring
slides.text: Reach: what can the agent actually do? Mandate: what was it authorised to do? Gap: who controls the difference? They sit at the centre.

slides.title: What it does not show
slides.text: No relationship with RiskMandate is drawn, because none is public. No ranking, no target list, no answers: for every company on the ring, we have not asked yet.

slides.title: Why it is here
slides.text: PrompTugal.news is powered by RiskMandate and is not independent of it; we say so on every page. This picture shows the lens, nothing more.
slides.link: Read how the lens is used

slides.title: The world map
slides.text: Every country with companies in the graph has a bubble sized by how many. A line runs from each to Lisbon, where Web Summit is held on 9 to 12 November 2026.

slides.title: Filter by field
slides.text: Pick a field and the bubbles shrink to its companies; some countries drop away. Tap a country for its companies, each linking to its page.

slides.title: A caution on countries
slides.text: The country is the one the graph holds for a company; for some it is where the speaker's listing puts them, not a sourced headquarters. A company page shows its source.

slides.title: The best of the graph
slides.text: Eight ready-made views of the explorer, each with a sentence on what it is telling you. Open one and keep exploring from it.

slides.title: Three more pictures
slides.text: Beyond the explorer: centres of gravity, the industry map, the world map and RiskMandate's ring, each a picture of the same companies.

slides.title: Companies at the summit
slides.text: Each profile holds public facts only, each with its source and the date it was read. Being listed is not an endorsement, and not a sign that we have met them.

slides.title: Three ways in
slides.text: By field groups them by what they do; by country by where the graph places them; A to Z is the plain list.

slides.title: See them as a picture
slides.text: The same companies as wells by field, as a tree, and on a world map.
